Fig. 1: The program embedding procedure. We use the same pretrained LLM to generate chunk embeddings for the source and LLVM IR code. The chunk embeddings are aggregated by separate LSTMs and concatenated to produce a program-level embedding. Note that while the LSTMs are trainable, the LLM is not fine-tuned.
